phases.ja: 1-2: その場で膝バウンス（だんだん強く）。両腕を体の横から頭上へゆっくり上げる

phases.ja: 3-4: 頭上で手首をクロスし、上半身を左右にツイスト

phases.ja: 7: 上体を少し後ろへ反らし溜める → 8: サビ頭に向けてシグネチャーポーズへ

phases.en_short: leans back, then lands in the signature pose

segments.energy_ja: 高。曲の顔になる反復フック

phases.ja: 1: シグネチャーポーズ（右手をカメラへ差し出す／左手はあご）
phases.en: starts in his signature pose, right hand reaching to the camera
phases.en_short: reaches to the camera in the signature pose

phases.ja: 2: 差し出した右手をぐっと握って胸に引き寄せる（“つかむ”）。重心を左脚へ
phases.en: closes the reaching hand into a fist and pulls it to his chest as if grabbing something, weight shifts to the left leg
phases.en_short: grabs the air and pulls the fist to his chest

phases.ja: 3-4: 両手を胸→お腹へなで下ろしながら胸から腰へボディロール、膝を曲げて沈む
phases.en: slides both hands down from chest to waist with a slow body roll from chest to hips, sinking into bent knees
phases.en_short: slides both hands down his chest in a slow body roll, knees bending

phases.ja: 5: 右足を寄せて体を左 45° に向け右肩ヒット → 6: 左肩ヒットで顔だけカメラへ
phases.en: steps the right foot in, turns 45 degrees left and hits the right shoulder, then the left shoulder as his head snaps to the camera
phases.en_short: turns 45 degrees left, hits right shoulder, then left shoulder, head snaps to camera

phases.ja: 7: 腰を右→左にスウェイ → 8: 脚を開いてシグネチャーポーズでキメ（右手をカメラへ）
phases.en: sways his hips right then left, then opens his stance and hits his signature pose again, reaching to the camera
phases.en_short: sways his hips, then hits the signature pose again

segments.move_name: Slide & Reveal（スライド＆リビール）
segments.energy_ja: 高。フックの変化形で飽きさせない

phases.ja: 1-2: 左へ大きくサイドスライド。右腕で頭上に大きな弧を描く
phases.en: does a wide side slide to his left while his right arm draws a big arc over his head
phases.en_short: slides left, right arm drawing a big arc overhead

phases.ja: 3-4: 腰を大きく 1 回転させるヒップロール、両手は腰

phases.en_short: rolls his hips in a big circle, hands on hips

phases.en_short: passes his hand across his face as a reveal, eyes to camera

phases.ja: 7: 両肩をすくめるショルダーシュラッグ → 8: シグネチャーポーズへ
phases.en: does a sharp shoulder shrug, then returns to his signature pose
phases.en_short: shrugs sharply, then returns to the signature pose

segments.move_name: Hook Cut → Freeze（フック短縮→ブレイクで静止）
segments.energy_ja: 高→静。音が抜ける瞬間に止める

phases.ja: 1: シグネチャーポーズ → 2: “つかむ” でフックの頭だけを見せる
phases.en: hits the signature reach, then grabs and pulls the fist to his chest
phases.en_short: reaches to the camera, then grabs to his chest

phases.ja: 3-4: 右肩・左肩のショルダーヒット（フック後半の要素）
phases.en: does two sharp shoulder hits, right then left
phases.en_short: hits right then left shoulder

phases.ja: 5-6: 音が抜けるブレイク。ピタッと静止→首だけをスローモーションで横へ回す
phases.en: the music drops out: he freezes completely, then turns only his head slowly to the side in slow motion
phases.en_short: freezes completely, then slowly turns only his head

phases.ja: 7: 右手をゆっくり目の高さに上げる → 8: ドロップに備え、低めのシグネチャーポーズで溜める
phases.en: slowly raises his right hand to eye level, then settles into a low signature pose, ready for the drop
phases.en_short: raises his hand to eye level, then settles into a low signature pose

segments.hint_ja: ブレイクは“止める”ことが最大の見せ場。動かしすぎない。

segments.move_name: Heavy Drop（ヘビー・ドロップ）

phases.ja: 1: ドロップと同時に右足で踏み込み（スタンプ）、両腕を一気に下へ振り下ろして胸を落とす
phases.en: on the drop he stomps his right foot and swings both arms down hard, dropping his chest
phases.en_short: stomps and swings both arms down hard on the drop

phases.ja: 2-4: 低い重心のハーフタイム・ボディロール×2、肩を大きく使う
phases.en: does two heavy half-time body rolls in a low stance, using his shoulders big
phases.en_short: does two heavy body rolls in a low stance

phases.ja: 5-6: フックの“差し出す→つかむ”をもう一度
phases.en: repeats the hook: reaches to the camera, then grabs and pulls the fist to his chest
phases.en_short: reaches to the camera, then grabs to his chest

phases.ja: 7: 体を右へ 1/4 ターン → 8: 正面に戻ってシグネチャーポーズ
phases.en: does a quarter turn to his right, then turns back and hits his signature pose
phases.en_short: quarter-turns right, then back into the signature pose

segments.hint_ja: 重低音に合わせて“重さ”を表現。上半身を落とすと格好良く見える。

segments.section_ja: ラストサビ/ドロップ(低音主体)
segments.energy_ja: 高→静。最後の小節頭で明確な決めポーズを打ち、音が消えるまでホールド

phases.ja: 1: シグネチャーポーズ（最後の“差し出す”）
phases.en: reaches to the camera in his signature pose one last time
phases.en_short: reaches to the camera in the signature pose

phases.ja: 2: 差し出した手をつかんで胸へ引き寄せる
phases.en: grabs and pulls the fist to his chest
phases.en_short: grabs and pulls the fist to his chest

phases.ja: 3: 胸→腰のボディロールで沈み、体を正面へ
phases.en: does a slow body roll sinking down, squaring his body to the camera
phases.en_short: does a slow body roll, squaring to the camera

phases.ja: 4: 立ち上がりながら右手 2 本指を眉の横から前へ（サリュート）
phases.en: rises with a two-finger salute from his brow toward the camera
phases.en_short: rises with a two-finger salute

phases.ja: 5〜最後: 最後の小節頭でキメ。脚を大きく開き、左手はベルト、右手の人差し指をまっすぐカメラへ、あごを引いて目線はカメラ。音が消えても完全静止でホールド
phases.en: hits the final pose on the last downbeat: wide stance, left hand on his belt, right index finger pointing straight at the camera, chin down, eyes locked on the camera, then holds completely still until the end
phases.en_short: hits the final pose: wide stance, left hand on belt, right finger pointing at the camera, then holds completely still

segments.hint_ja: 最後は完全静止。動画の最後のフレームがそのままサムネイル候補になる。
